name: OpenVibe.Work
tagline: Find work, with an agent on your side.
description: OpenVibe.Work gathers job listings from open job boards (Arbeitnow, Remotive and RemoteOK) into one search, shows a short excerpt with the board named and links every listing back to where you apply, and keeps your saved searches with a count of what is new. Any search is also a feed OpenVibe.Watch can follow for alerts, and your OpenVibe.Actor agent helps you prepare an application, asking before every step.

pillars.title: Every listing sourced
pillars.text: Where it came from and when, always shown.

pillars.title: Watch for fits
pillars.text: Get told when a job that matches appears.

pillars.title: An agent that helps
pillars.text: Drafts, tailors and tracks applications — you approve.

pillars.title: Yours to control
pillars.text: Your profile and history stay yours, exportable any time.

faq.question: Where do the jobs come from?
faq.answer: From the public job-board APIs of Arbeitnow, Remotive and RemoteOK, read every six hours. Each listing names its board and links to the original, where you read the full listing and apply.

faq.question: Do you copy the whole job post?
faq.answer: No. OpenVibe.Work keeps a short plain-text excerpt and sends you to the board for the rest, as the boards ask.

faq.question: Is it free?
faq.answer: Yes. Searching needs no account; a free OpenVibe account keeps your saved searches.

faq.question: Can it tell me when new jobs match?
faq.answer: Saved searches show how many listings are new since you last looked. Notifications come with OpenVibe.Watch.

faq.question: Will an AI apply for me?
faq.answer: No, never without you: your OpenVibe.Actor agent helps you prepare an application (it drafts, you review and change it), and it asks before every step. Applying stays on the job board, by you.
